description: Specs/files: scripts/docker_entrypoint.sh, provision_database.sh and docker_database SQL orchestration; canonical receipt hook retains atomicity but no file/token state. DATABASE_URL owner input unchanged; DBA libpq env and ZAQ owner/reader passwords kept separate. Tests first in existing administrative ExUnit suite: default dispatch, fresh automatic provision, post-migration restart, credentials not rotated, explicit migrated guard, missing params, engine selection, receipt mismatch and restricted owner authentication. Real psql/Postgrex no internal mocks; shell stub release only OS boundary. Docs database-setup. No Python or installer variant. DAG .5 -> .6 -> .7.
title: [zaq-f6s] Simplify entrypoint to environment-only shell provisioning
